query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM collection_actions; SELECT ca.receivableId, ca.status, ar.estado as ar_estado, ar.cliente FROM collection_actions ca LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ca.receivableId = ar.id LIMIT 20;
